'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Rafah offensive]], [[Refugee camp airstrikes in the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[May 2024 Al-Mawasi refugee camp attack]]
****At least 21 people are killed and 64 others are injured in a [[Israel]]i attack on a tent camp in [[al-Mawasi]], [[Rafah Governorate]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/28/at-least-21-killed-dozens-wounded-in-israeli-attacks-on-gazas-rafah (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] tanks reach central [[Rafah]] for the first time with heavy clashes being reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-press-rafah-offensive-despite-global-outcry-2024-05-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The [[U.S.]] removes the [[Gaza floating pier]] from the [[Gaza Strip]] for repair after its [[flotilla]] was damaged in bad weather. [https://apnews.com/article/gaza-pier-damage-weather-seas-boats-f45634fb85e2ac6aec9b814c36ea3526 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***Russian [[guided bomb]]s hit a block of [[apartment]]s in [[Toretsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], killing at least two civilians and injuring six others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-bombs-kill-two-eastern-ukraine-officials-say-2024-05-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]] 
**A [[Marshall Islands]]-flagged [[bulk carrier]] takes on water after being hit by three missiles off the coast of [[Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/vessel-tilts-off-yemens-coast-after-attack-by-missiles-ambrey-says-2024-05-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Cyclone Remal]]
**Seventeen people are killed and six others are missing after a stone [[quarry]] collapses due to strong winds in [[Aizawl]], [[Mizoram]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/mizoram/five-dead-several-missing-as-stone-quarry-collapses-in-mizoram-amid-rains/article68224019.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*[[Realty Building explosion]]
**One person is killed and seven others are injured in a natural [[gas explosion]] at an apartment building in [[Youngstown, Ohio]], U.S. [https://apnews.com/article/ohio-explosion-youngstown-bank-5e42d259adeb3fb1d782133a3f2f6e82 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International recognition of the State of Palestine]]
**[[Norway–Palestine relations]], [[Ireland–Palestine relations]], [[Palestine–Spain relations]]
***The governments of [[Norway]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], and [[Spain]] officially recognise the [[State of Palestine]], after declaring their intention to do so on May 22. [https://www.thejournal.ie/ireland-recognising-palestine-6391201-May2024/ (''The Journal'')] [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/05/28/spain-to-recognise-palestinian-state-in-historic-decision (Euronews)] [https://apnews.com/article/eu-palestinian-state-spain-israel-gaza-6efe351e53761befc2c539c535bbcc0c (AP)]
**[[Denmark–Palestine relations]]
***The [[Folketing|Parliament of Denmark]] rejects a proposal to recognise a [[State of Palestine|Palestinian state]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/danish-parliament-rejects-proposal-recognise-palestinian-state-2024-05-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war protests#North America|Israel–Hamas war protests]]
***Pro-[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] protestors in [[Mexico]] set fire to the [[List of diplomatic missions of Israel|Israeli embassy]] in [[Mexico City]]. [https://www.thejc.com/news/world/rioters-set-fire-to-israeli-embassy-in-mexico-city-tr3313lu (''The Jewish Chronicle'')] [https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/cdmx/2024/5/28/encapuchados-enfrentan-policias-frente-la-embajada-de-israel-en-mexico-329888.html (''Proceso'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Animal rights in Colombia]]
**The [[Senate of Colombia]] approves a resolution banning [[Spanish-style bullfighting]] in [[Colombia|the country]]. [https://www.lafm.com.co/politica/prohiben-corridas-de-toros-en-colombia (La FM)]
*[[Bankruptcy of FTX]]
**Former [[FTX]] co-CEO [[Ryan Salame]] is sentenced to more than seven years in prison and fined more than $11 million for [[fraud]] and [[criminal conspiracy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/former-bankman-fried-lieutenant-salame-sentenced-90-months-prison-2024-05-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Belarus–European Union border crisis]]
**A [[Border Guard (Poland)|Polish Border Guard]] soldier is seriously injured in an incident among a surge in migrants trying to cross the [[European Union|EU]] border from [[Belarus]]. [https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7784/Artykul/3384535,update-polish-soldier-stabbed-at-belarus-border-pm-to-visit-site (Polskie Radio)]
*[[South Africa's genocide case against Israel]]
**[[Mexico]] announces it will intervene in support of [[South Africa]] in South Africa's genocide case against [[Israel]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/mexico-seeks-join-south-africa-genocide-case-against-israel-icj (''Middle East Eye'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023–2024 Georgian protests]]
**The [[Georgian parliament]] overrides a presidential veto of the foreign agents law, thereby requiring president [[Salome Zourabichvili]] to endorse the bill within five days. [https://www.dw.com/en/georgia-parliament-pushes-through-foreign-agents-law/a-69206864 (DW)]
*[[2024 Taiwanese legislative reform protests]]
**The [[Kuomintang]] and [[Taiwan People's Party]] pass amendments granting the [[Legislative Yuan]] greater powers to oversee the executive and to question officials and citizens, despite claims that these amendments violate civil liberties and could reduce the powers of president [[Lai Ching-te]] of the [[Democratic Progressive Party]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/28/taiwan-passes-controversial-reform-bill-after-violence-and-protests (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Haitian crisis]]
**[[Garry Conille]] is named the new [[Prime Minister of Haiti]] by the [[Transitional Presidential Council]]. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-new-prime-minister-transitional-council-c6f9e0785271f6ed96785e7ed7ffcfdc (AP)]
